elias_intro.speaker: elias
elias_intro.text: Seven generations of my family have worked on this grand astrolabe for House Sabreth. Four hundred moving gears of silver-bronze, all tracking the celestial dance. But the seventh solstice dial is off by three arc-seconds, and the Conclave inspection is tomorrow!

start_quest.title: Seven Solstices
start_quest.desc: Assist Crafter Elias in calibrating a delicate multi-generational astrolabe for House Sabreth.
stages: Inspect the master astrolabe in the Sabreth brass workshop
Align the seven solstice gear trains

choices.text: [Acumen Check] The error isn't in your gears, Elias. It's the gravitational precession caused by the caldera's volcanic magma chambers.
[Celerity Check] Let me adjust the micro-escapement teeth with precision jeweller's tweezers.
Show me the differential gear train connecting the lunar and solar arms.

elias_explain.speaker: elias
elias_explain.text: Look at the main escapement arbor. Every time the winter solstice arm sweeps across the Great Bear constellation, the tension slips.

choices.text: We need to re-cut the counter-weight tension curve.

elias_acumen_pass.speaker: elias
elias_acumen_pass.text: Volcanic precession! By the stars, of course! My grandfather calculated this for sea-level gravity, not the caldera rim!

choices.text: Apply the elevation correction constant to the gear ratios.

elias_acumen_fail.speaker: elias
elias_acumen_fail.text: I've checked every tooth twice. If I can't find the deviation, Sabreth will strip our workshop charter.

choices.text: Let's calibrate the gears against tonight's actual star positions.

elias_celerity_pass.speaker: elias
elias_celerity_pass.text: Incredible hand precision! You slipped the balance spring without scratching the enamel dial even once.

choices.text: Lock the set screw and test the sweep.

elias_resolve.speaker: elias
elias_resolve.text: Hear that clean, rhythmic ticking? Exactly on the second! House Sabreth will have the most accurate star-measure in the caldera. I am forever in your debt.
